presetDialog.name: Name
presetDialog.fxTooltip: Calculated from other inputs once the required values are present

presetHelp.spindleRpm: Spindle speed n for this cut. Surface speed follows from diameter and rpm — or rpm from surface speed.
presetHelp.surfaceSpeed: Cutting speed vc at the tooth (m/min). Typical for material and tool; ties rpm to effective diameter.
presetHelp.rampSpindleRpm: Spindle speed during ramp or helix entry. Defaults to cutting rpm; can be set lower separately to reduce load or vibration.
presetHelp.feedMmMin: Feed during the actual peripheral or contour cut (mm/min). Relates to feed per tooth, rpm, and flute count.
presetHelp.feedPerTooth: Feed per tooth fz (mm). Computed from cutting feed, rpm, and flutes — or cutting feed from fz.
presetHelp.rampAngle: Ramp angle for angled or spiral entry (degrees). Small values are common; too steep increases tool load.
presetHelp.leadIn: Feed when entering the contour (e.g. path start), often equal to cutting feed.
presetHelp.leadOut: Feed when exiting the contour (e.g. path end), often equal to cutting feed.
presetHelp.transition: Feed in transitions or curves; whether CAM uses this stored value depends on the software.
presetHelp.helix: Feed during helix or spiral entry (not straight in Z). Often a fraction of cutting feed by default.
presetHelp.plunge: Feed for straight plunge in Z (mm/min). Usually much lower than cutting feed to avoid overload.
presetHelp.plungePerRev: Plunge distance per spindle revolution (mm/rev). Plunge feed divided by rpm — useful when rpm and feed are coupled.
presetHelp.maxStepdown: Maximum depth of cut per pass (mm) when using depth stepdown from the preset.
presetHelp.maxStepover: Maximum lateral step per pass (mm) when using stepover from the preset.

presetWarnings.missingDiameter: Diameter missing or invalid — surface speed and rpm cannot be linked.
presetWarnings.invalidFlutes: Flute count missing or invalid — feed and feed per tooth cannot be linked.
